project_name: Aligned CMH-02 Conesville data center campus
aliases: Aligned Data Centers Coshocton County campus
status_detail: Company announced July 24, 2025 planned multi-building campus on 197 acres inside Conesville Industrial Park adjacent to former AEP Conesville Power Plant; company said first data center has a foundational customer and targets initial capacity delivery mid-2026; county minutes note Oct. 1, 2025 commendation for groundbreaking.
notes: Capacity not stated in official announcement; Cleanview separately lists Building 1 as 86 MW planned, but this row keeps official capacity null.

status_detail: No confirmed data center project found in county official site, Crawford Partnership economic development pages, or local search. Search found anti-data-center petition/social posts and generic service-provider SEO pages, but no developer, permit, abatement, rezoning, or named project.
notes: Crawford Partnership pages emphasize available sites/incentives and Ohio Crossroads Industrial Center; no data center announcement located.

project_name: Lakeland Equity Group Slavic Village hyperscale data center
status_detail: Cleveland rejected a May 5, 2026 zoning/permit application for a two-story 300,000 sq ft hyperscale facility on a 35-acre site between East 49th and East 55th Streets; later reporting described it as a proposed 150 MW project while city considered a data-center moratorium.
notes: City social media statement is quoted in Signal Cleveland; no developer project page found.

project_name: H5 Data Centers Cleveland data center
status_detail: H5 operates a 351,000 sq ft Cleveland colocation/carrier-hotel facility; H5 says the Cleveland facility was the first multi-tenant data center to qualify for Ohio's data center tax abatement program.
notes: Capacity from OCOLO tracker; H5 official source confirms facility size and operation.

status_detail: Expedient lists a Cleveland data center; Cogent's service-location list identifies Expedient - Garfield Heights 1 at 15166 NEO Parkway as a Cleveland-area data-center service location.
notes: Included as existing colocation facility; capacity not found in official sources during quick pass.

status_detail: Cogent's service-location list identifies Involta - Independence at 7300 East Pleasant Valley Road as a Cleveland metro data-center service location.
notes: Carrier/service-location evidence only; no separate Involta facility page located in quick pass.

status_detail: No confirmed project found on Darke County Economic Development site or local/news searches. Local articles and social posts discuss opposition/signature gathering around possible future data centers, but identify no specific project, developer, parcel, permit, or abatement.
notes: Stop Ohio Data Centers page explicitly says no active data center in Darke County yet.

status_detail: No confirmed project found on Defiance County official site or Defiance County Economic Development pages. EDA blog posts mention community discussion around the Elliott Road site and data centers, while stating the conversation is not advocating for a specific data center project.
notes: Treat as no confirmed project; monitor Elliott Road site discussion if a developer or application emerges.

project_name: Cologix COL5 Orange Township data center
status_detail: Construction underway on $1 billion AI-ready colocation facility at 6787 Green Meadows Drive in Orange Township; phase 1 expected fall 2026 with 25 MW, with phase 2 adding 95 MW. Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a 50%, 10-year sales tax exemption for Cologix projects in Delaware and Licking counties.
notes: Capacity combines Delaware Source report of 25 MW phase 1 plus 95 MW phase 2 attributed to Cologix website.

status_detail: Local reporting says a nearby Csquare/Centersquare data center at 8180 Green Meadows Drive North has been around since 2007.
notes: Included to avoid missing older colocation facility near COL5; capacity not found in quick pass.

status_detail: Local reporting notes Sunbury passed a moratorium on data centers in April 2026, halting further progress on a proposed Amazon data center project until 2027.
notes: Project details sparse; retained as early/proposed item because local reporting identifies Amazon and a municipal moratorium.

aliases: Aligned Data Centers Erie County site
status_detail: JobsOhio announced Sept. 27, 2023 that Aligned Data Centers was considering expanding into Ohio and developing an Erie County site into a data center campus in Sandusky; ODOD approved tax credit assistance, with $202 million capital investment and 18 committed IT jobs.
notes: Official JobsOhio source confirms project but not MW; PoweredByWho lists Erie County combined capacity 96 MW.

status_detail: Google lists Lancaster as one of its Central Ohio data center communities. Cleanview tracks Lancaster Building 1 as 75 MW operational in 2024 and Building 2 as 76 MW operational in 2025.
notes: Official Google source confirms Lancaster community; building-level MW/year from Cleanview tracker.

project_name: Vantage OH2 Millersport data center campus
status_detail: Ohio Governor/Tax Credit Authority announcement says Vantage Data Centers Management Company will establish a new facility in Millersport, Fairfield County, with 37 FTE jobs, $3.7 million annual payroll, $2.1 billion fixed-asset investment, and a 50%, 10-year Data Center Tax Exemption; local/tracker sources describe an OH2 Millersport campus with about 500 acres and 800 MW full buildout, under construction as of 2026.
notes: Official sources confirm investment/location/incentive; 800 MW and current construction status from tracker/local synthesis, not state announcement.

project_name: Amazon Jefferson Township data center campus
aliases: Midwest Mega Commerce Center data center
status_detail: DCD reported AWS filed documents while exploring a data center location at Midwest Mega Commerce Center in Jefferson Township; OCC/FERC filing said operations could start in September 2026 and first-phase transmission upgrades would exceed $22 million. Fayette County commissioner minutes in 2024 adopted zoning text allowing data centers on industrial parcels.
notes: Capacity from Ryan Grissinger tracker; DCD says AWS had not disclosed size/cost/jobs at time of report.

status_detail: Google lists Columbus as one of its Ohio data center communities; AP reported in 2024 that Google was investing further in three Ohio data center campuses including one under construction in Columbus.
notes: Capacity not found in official source during quick pass.

project_name: Google New Albany data center campus
status_detail: Google lists New Albany as a Central Ohio data center community and says it has invested in Ohio since breaking ground in New Albany in 2019.
notes: New Albany International Business Park spans Franklin and Licking counties; included for Franklin coverage based on county-level trackers and local geography.

status_detail: Meta's official New Albany data center page describes operational data center buildings and clean-energy support for the New Albany Data Center.
notes: Baxtel says the site consists of five data centers totaling about 2.5 million sq ft; capacity not found in official Meta page.

project_name: Amazon Web Services Hayden Run data center campus
status_detail: DCD reported AWS's first Hilliard facility at 5109 Hayden Run began construction in 2015, AWS opened its Ohio Cloud region in 2016, and the company was wrapping up the fifth/final building there while planning a third Hilliard campus.
notes: Datacenters.com lists 5113 Hayden Run Rd and 154,000 sq ft; capacity not found.

project_name: Amazon Web Services Scioto Darby data center campus
status_detail: City of Hilliard reported an AWS proposal to add a fuel-cell system to power its data center campus on Scioto Darby Road would proceed without city approval under state law; local advocacy materials identify 228 natural-gas fuel cells and 73 MW capacity.
notes: 73 MW refers to proposed fuel-cell power system, not necessarily total IT capacity.

status_detail: Cologix lists COL1, COL2 and COL3 at 535, 555 and 585 Scherers Court; DCD reported Cologix operated three facilities at Scherers Court and the campus had capacity for up to 30 MW.
notes: Cologix official page confirms facilities/addresses; DCD provides 30 MW campus capacity.

status_detail: Cologix lists COL4 at 7500 Alta View, Columbus; Baxtel/DCD describe COL4 as a 256,000 sq ft data center offering 27 MW and taking Cologix's Columbus capacity toward about 66 MW.
notes: Capacity from DCD/Datacenters.com; official Cologix page confirms address and operating campus listing.

status_detail: Vantage official page says its OH1 New Albany campus spans 70 acres and will house three two-story hyperscale data centers totaling 192 MW across 1.5 million sq ft; first building slated operational by December 2025 with additional phases through 2028.
notes: New Albany area spans county boundary; included in Franklin batch because regional county trackers place New Albany facilities in Franklin/Licking context.

project_name: QTS New Albany 1 data center campus
status_detail: Data center maps/trackers list QTS New Albany 1 as a two-building data center campus in New Albany near 1225/1235 Beech Rd SW; no official QTS page located in quick pass.
notes: Tracker-only inclusion to avoid missing planned New Albany campus; verify with permits/owner records in a deeper pass.
